summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Banco Santander-Chile, a foreign issuer, reporting its unaudited consolidated financial information for the period ending June 30, 2026. The filing contains summarized balance sheet and income statement data in both English and Spanish, along with a note that the financials are prepared under the Compendium of Accounting Standards for Banks issued by the Chilean Financial Market Commission. No event, transaction, or corporate action triggering a special-situation classification is disclosed. This is a standard periodic financial report with no deal terms or special-situations content.
